{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient, as per data dictionary

# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

print(f'Deduplicated shape: {df_dedup.shape}')
print(df_dedup["severity"].value_counts(normalize=True))"}
